evidence.detail: assert sort_order in ['ASC', 'DESC'] — AssertionError is not registered in flask error handlers, so an invalid sort_order returns 500/HTML instead of 400/JSON; same pattern repeats at lines 61, 80, 100, 116, 132, 150, 195
sort_options[sort_by] with no try/except — KeyError on invalid sort_by key produces unhandled 500
int(request.args.get('personId', 0)) with no try/except — ValueError on non-integer personId produces 500
Only BadRequestException and DoesNotExistException are registered as error handlers; InvalidArgumentException and AssertionError are not, so they surface as 500s
Pagination catches InvalidArgumentException and re-raises as BadRequest, but order_by calls do not — inconsistent coverage

triage.notes: Checklist in the issue also requests ASC/DESC and sort_by dicts to be converted to enums — a design-level refactor beyond just adding exception handling. Scope exceeds easy-fix threshold.
